g.text: csk audit, build, dry-run, commit, and rollback lifecycle
Acquire no project or mutation lock
Parse schema v6 and validate build roots
Validate full tree, hash build source,
and exclude build roots from context
Build provider-first closure and collision plan
Create private probe root, disable telemetry,
Compute canonical inputs and keys, then inspect
No go list or go build.
No audit, registry, lock, journal, cache,
runtime, context, marker, shim, consumer, or GC write.
Select provider-first node and lexical command
Run fixed go list and validate full graph
Run fixed go build into private staging
Leave all persistent installation and cache state unchanged
Verify, permission, and hash staged artifact
Recover journals and revalidate cache trust,
shared generations, target preimages, and plan
Release home lock and restart from
earliest affected read or build step
Publish missing immutable cache entries atomically
Commit adapters, mirrors, and stale removals
Restore journaled targets in exact reverse order
Retain or remove transaction-owned cache only
when a locked fresh mark proves safety
Run runtime, snapshot, and build-cache GC
Release home lock and project lock
